emails.subject: Your post on nearshoring
emails.html:
Hello,

I read your 14 October post on whether global shipping disruptions make nearshoring a smarter choice for UK businesses. When routes and costs keep moving, customers ask for fresh quotes more often, and your ocean, air, road and customs teams in Witham and Ipswich price each one.

We are Tiph, a software company in London, and we built Kazinga for the quoting side of a forwarder's day. It uses AI to read incoming rate requests, then prices them from your own tariffs and margin, and drafts the reply. Your team checks every quote and sends it. Your data is stored in the EU and encrypted, and Tiph cannot read it.

We can also set Kazinga up to quote each customer from their own past quotes and orders, as a customisation aimed at raising the value of each account.

Would a 20-minute demo be useful?

Kind regards,
Ratif Ssemujju
